messages:
maya: flagging an odd regression during compact-xl q4 canary on staging. mixed Han + RTL fragments show punctuation mirroring plus stray zero-width chars in decode. quick summary:
- fp32 BLEU: 30.7 chrF: 56.0
- q8 BLEU: 30.5 chrF: 55.7
- q4 BLEU: 25.3 chrF: 50.9 (mixed-orientation subset)
- failing samples show extra U+200B/U+200D bytes and parentheses reversed in decode only on q4 runtime

maya: minimal input used:
```
()   
( is placeholder) actual: (你好) 0 0 \n```

maya: fp32 decode: "(你好) — שלום [世界]"
maya: q4 decode: ")你好( \u200b— שלום ]世界["  (closing paren moves, ZWSP/ZWJ-like marks inserted before CJK bracket)

cheng: did the q4 artifact pick up the new emit-utf8-chunk kernel? last time a chunked emit change produced stray bytes at chunk boundaries. i'll diff tokenizer.json, normalization flags, and runtime bundle metadata. @li-wei can you run sentencepiece vs tokenizers and paste token dumps? :mag:

li-wei: running small repro. sentencepiece roundtrips fine. tokenizers (v0.13 in q4 bundle) shows inserted markers:
- sentencepiece tokens: ['(', '你好', ')', ' ', '\u2014', ' ', 'שלום', ' ', '[', '世界', ']']
- tokenizers (q4): ['(', '\u200b', '你好', ')', ' ', '\u2014', ' ', 'שלום', ' ', ']', '\u200d', '[', '世界', ']']
I pushed a minimal repro gist: https://gist.github.com/li-wei/zwj-emit-1789

rachel: saw similar on a different bringup (compact-lite) — it was a combo of pre-normalize=false and chunked-emits mapping multi-byte sequences incorrectly. if normalization toggles, bidi reordering can behave differently and mirror punctuation.

sahil: bisecting emit-utf8-chunk now. local run with --disable-utf8-chunk writes full strings and matches fp32. with chunking enabled I reproduce extra 0xE2 0x80 0x8B bytes crossing chunk boundary; postprocess maps those to U+200B or U+200D in certain contexts. looks like off-by-one in chunk tail copy. attaching velo trace to INF-1301.

eval-bot: CI scan https://ci.redwood/run/9229 -> regression flagged on mixed-orientation/evalset-V4 (delta BLEU -5.4). artifacts at artifacts/9229/mixed-orient-samples.jsonl

maya: actions: 1) @cheng diff pre-normalize flags and tokenizer meta between builds, 2) @li-wei run the repro across full mixed-orientation subset and push token dumps, 3) @sahil continue kernel bisect (if confirmed revert emit-utf8-chunk for q4 canary), 4) i'll open issue INF-1301 and pin gist + CI artifacts. if tokenizers disagree we hotfix tokenizer; if runtime-only we rollback kernel.

cheng: quick find: q4 bundle shipped tokenizers pre-normalize=false (defaults) while fp32 enforced NFKC pre-normalize. pushing branch force-nfkc-pre (PR #3521) that applies NFKC before tokenization and strips stray ZWSP/ZWJ from token boundaries.

li-wei: validating PR #3521 on the repro gist and full subset now. initial 50-sample run shows BLEU recovered by ~3.8 on mixed subset. running full set and will post results.

sahil: confirming bisect: emit-utf8-chunk commit c7a3 added tail-copy optimization causing off-by-one for multi-byte utf-8 across output chunks. local revert removes stray bytes and fixes decode. preparing emergency revert for q4 canary while we land longer fix.

maya: thanks team. keep updates terse here. i'll summarize root cause, mitigation (revert + PR), and next steps in INF-1301 and notify release owners. :thumbsup:
